linx_native_interface.model_at_tabulation_nodes: log R_i(T) = log R_med_i(T) + s_i(T)*q_i, s_i=log(expsigma_i)
linx_native_interface.default_q: all zero; no random joint prior imposed by this call
linx_native_interface.correlated_amplitudes: draw z with covariance I; q=Lz where L L^T=C_q; pass same q to both adapters with reaction ordering checked
linx_native_interface.expressible_covariance: Cov[log R_i(T), log R_j(Tprime)] = s_i(T)*C_q[i,j]*s_j(Tprime) at grid nodes / compatible log interpolation
linx_native_interface.boundary: One scalar per reaction yields a fixed temperature shape, not an arbitrary multi-mode covariance over (reaction,T). Analytic/custom rates may have a different q meaning and must declare it.

inputs_required: joint S-factor posterior or joint rate-function samples
general_extension: If the posterior requires several temperature modes, use log R_i(T)=log Rmed_i(T)+sum_k B_ik(T) z_k or supplied joint tables through an explicit adapter. Do not squeeze arbitrary rate-function covariance into one q_i.

counterfactual.B: product of the SAME marginal rate-function posteriors
counterfactual.non_gaussian_case: resample product marginals; zero covariance alone does not establish independence
counterfactual.prior_work: S3_COVARIANCE; this is its interface continuation, not a new physical result

observational_eta_policy: Declare free eta_BBN versus CMB conditioning and photon-production map eta_BBN→eta_CMB; count shared CMB information once.
